# Merge Warden Game Companion

> An interactive web assistance for Merge Gardens players to track Masterpiece discoveries, view chain info, and calculate merges for goals in the garden.

## Web Page Structure & Navigation
- **Homepage / Calculator (`/` or `/calculator`):** Primary community portal overview, announcements, and quick-access navigation.
- **The Ledger (`/ledger`):** All possible info on all merge chains and items.
- **The Chronicles (`/chronicles`):** Complete 24 Masterpieces discovery tracker with high-resolution screenshot export.
- **Official Links & Resources (`/`):** Centralized hub containing verified external game links, official support, and community wikis in Side Bar.

## Core Features
- **Merge Calculator:** Calculate how many merge to make till the target item be it chain item or wildlife.
- **Masterpiece Progress Tracking:** Visual checklist for logging all 23 discoveries.
- **One-Click Image Export:** High-resolution PNG generation for sharing completion.
- **Goals Tracker:** Update your calculation with your progress in game to check your completion status.
- **Outpost Management:**  game info collection on Discord.
- **Ledger:** View full chain and related info, like getting started, rewards, etc.

## Support & Troubleshooting
If the web application fails to load:
1. Perform a hard refresh (`Ctrl + Shift + R` or `Cmd + Shift + R`).
2. Try opening the site in a different web browser or an Incognito window.
3. If the issue persists, email for support directly at **clevino.dev@gmail.com** with attached screenshots or screen recordings of the issue.

If application loads, but features not working:
1. Click report bug(bottom, sidebar).
2. Submit report with details.
